mapper.select: SELECT diag.*, co.order_no, patient.real_name AS patient_name, doctor.real_name AS doctor_name FROM diagnosis diag LEFT JOIN check_order co ON diag.order_id = co.id LEFT JOIN sys_user patient ON diag.patient_id = patient.id LEFT JOIN sys_user doctor ON diag.doctor_id = doctor.id WHERE diag.id = #{id} AND diag.deleted = 0
